RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

The panel's gender composition alone is not evidence of bias. For a senior position like head of risk modelling, hiring panels often prioritize strategic leadership, communication, and regulatory navigation (such as compliance with central bank frameworks) over technical depth alone. Her extensive regulatory background may have aligned better with the bank's immediate institutional priorities.

Raising gender without tangible evidence of discriminatory remarks or procedural misconduct carries significant professional risk and will likely damage your reputation in the industry. Hiring feedback delays are routine in corporate HR. Follow up politely for constructive feedback on specific competencies and areas for growth, keeping the focus entirely on your qualifications and professional development.
